title: Dazo
stack: Vue JS, Laravel, Bootstrap CSS, Golang, MongoDB
description: Dazo App is a Software as a Service (SaaS) company specializing in creating an AI-based order management platform. It helps MSMEs manage their businesses automatically. Equipped with an Order Management System, AI Chat Assistant, and Digital Store, you can process orders faster, manage customer chats, and create a professional online store layout tailored to your business needs.
